_doc: this.<registrar>(...) → what it becomes. kind: trigger = Ability.on [on]; observer = reaction/interrupt with `when` (tables/triggers.json); persistent = PersistentEffect (host: whileAttached). flags: the registrar's `play|reap|fight: true` props add triggers (keyteki Card.reaction). unsupported: the reason code. Lote 15e: interrupt = observer na janela BEFORE (o when passa por tables/triggers.json; o campo `before` da tabela escolhe a forma before do gatilho — onFight → beforeFight).
